title: Compute a word game tile score
summary: Calculate a Scrabble-like tile score for a word.
requirements: Letter scores: 1 AEIOULNRST; 2 DG; 3 BCMP; 4 FHVWY; 5 K; 8 JX; 10 QZ.
Ignore case; input contains only English letters.
hints: Build a lookup from letter to points.
Add the score of each uppercased letter.
